replaces.idea: A divided dual-basin silicon bath on short feet, with one purple basin and one orange basin separated by a raised teal divider wall.
A thick copper busbar mounted on two insulator blocks with a jagged electromigration void eaten out of its top edge.
A stepped three-tier rack of parallel metal rails bolted to two upright porcelain insulator posts.

new.name: Complementary Tub
new.concept: Complementary N-well and P-well CMOS substrate isolation
new.depicts: A divided ceramic-and-silicon dual-basin bath standing on four short feet, with a purple-tinted left basin and an orange-tinted right basin separated by a raised teal divider wall.
new.focal: The raised teal isolation wall dividing the two differently tinted basins.

new.name: Electromigration Void
new.concept: Electromigration voiding in a high-current metal interconnect
new.depicts: A thick orange copper busbar mounted on two dark insulator blocks, with a jagged dark-ink pit eaten out of its top edge.
new.focal: The jagged dark void notch carved into the busbar's upper edge.

new.name: Metal Busbar Rack
new.concept: Multi-layer metal routing and inter-layer dielectric spacing
new.depicts: A stepped three-tier rack of parallel copper and purple metal rails bolted to two upright porcelain insulator posts.
new.focal: The stacked metal rails separated by air-gap spacers between the upright posts.

new.name: Wafer Microprobe
new.depicts: A miniature brass-and-steel needle probe arm angled down from a weighted benchtop stand onto a tiny silicon pad.
new.focal: The fine needle tip touching the silicon pad.

new.name: Planarizing Platen
new.concept: Chemical-mechanical planarization (CMP) of metal and dielectric layers
new.depicts: A heavy circular polishing platen on a squat pedestal with a rotating spindle arm pressing a wafer carrier disk flat against its teal pad.
new.focal: The flat wafer carrier disk pressed against the circular polishing pad.

new.name: Quartz Reticle
new.depicts: A framed quartz glass plate standing upright in a slotted dark-metal easel, etched with a tiny crisp grid pattern.
new.focal: The etched grid pattern inside the upright glass frame.

new.name: Dielectric Sandwich
new.depicts: Two parallel metal plates clamped upright in a dark ceramic base, separated by a thin glowing teal dielectric slab.
new.focal: The thin teal dielectric slab sandwiched between the two upright plates.
